processing_scope: All 210 imported source episodes (Oct 27 through Nov 7), completed lab primitives and separately reviewed Nov 7 locomotion.
interval_convention: [start_frame, end_frame), exact source frame indices; 30 FPS
boundary_policy: Approach/lift onset through post-operation raised-hand retreat, with short context; gaps and small overlapping context are permitted; retain continuous frames inside each primitive.
review_method: All 75 episode ego contact sheets and gripper/EEF timelines reviewed; targeted wrist close-ups resolve failed grasps, supported rack/bath release, and dropped objects. Boundaries are motion-based estimates, not force/contact annotations.
label_limit: Labels describe visually supported manipulation and recorded squeeze events; actual aspirated/dispensed liquid volume is not measured.
